t.why: Timber and fishing are its main industries, and tuna fishing licences bring in large revenue.
t.rel: It has had deep security ties with Australia since an Australian-led peacekeeping force arrived during unrest in 2003. That is why its 2022 security pact with China alarmed Australia and the United States. It shares a sea border with Papua New Guinea.
t.know: It is made up of more than 900 islands.
t.etext: Timber was most of its exports, but its forests are shrinking. It also sells fish and gold.
